project.name: Quality Runner review and handoff output
project.identity: The Quality Runner projection and reporting boundary for human and agent review.
project.audience: Reviewers and downstream workflows consuming quality findings or remediation plans.
project.core_loop: Read an audit result, project findings and plan context, preserve blockers and unknowns, and emit a reviewable handoff.
project.north_star: A consumer can act on a quality result without reconstructing hidden assumptions or losing blocked work.

scope.purpose: Turn audit evidence into review-ready findings, plans, and handoff artifacts that preserve uncertainty and next actions.
scope.boundary: Owns review projection, reporting, response, and handoff-facing application modules; audit collection and external consumer adapters remain outside this child.

mvp.definition: The scoped boundary is explicitly ratified, its parent outcome is clear, and its smallest local proof is repeatable.

complete_product.definition: The scoped boundary remains aligned through changes, interfaces, and user-visible or consumer-facing verification.

outcomes.name: The Quality Runner review and handoff output boundary advances its parent outcome without silently taking on sibling responsibilities.

layers.planned: Local proof and sibling contracts are pending the boundary decision.
layers.verified: No independently scoped end-to-end proof has been accepted yet.
